verdict.rationale: The skills CLI documents a non-interactive, CI/CD-friendly install path (`npx skills add ... --skill frontend-design -g -a claude-code -y`) that selects the skill, agent and scope by flag. A runtime probe shows it runs keylessly via `npx -y` and detects when a coding agent is driving it, switching itself to promptless mode. Private repos reuse existing auth, so no interactive login is needed. missing for 10: hands-on confirmation of a complete headless install run end to end (files written and verified), not just version output and the non-interactive detection message.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can install a skill by itself — a non-interactive, promptless install path an agent can run headlessly end to end

citations.quote:
# Non-interactive installation (CI/CD friendly)
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill frontend-design -g -a claude-code -y
it auto-detected it was being driven by a coding agent ('claude-code_2-1-245_agent — installing non-interactively'), switching to promptless mode by itself
The CLI uses the authentication already configured for the repository URL
